text: 全球央行艰难重启加息周期，这次有什么不同|海外市场月报 许多机构实际上在减少美元资产配置的同时，增加对新兴市场资产的配置。
text_en: Global central banks struggle to restart the rate hike cycle, what is different this time | Overseas Market Monthly Report Many institutions are actually reducing US dollar asset allocations while increasing allocations to emerging market assets.
